title: skills: `objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` still teaches `^17.0.0` for every @objectstack/* dependency, while the scaffolders now write the exact version (the governed half of #25510)
body:
Filing gate **②**: a defect a seat read on `main`. Relayed from the `domain:devx` seat, which left it because `skills/**` is governed; filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287). Grade suggested S, p3; triage may regrade.

## Business rationale

- **Who benefits:** anyone who builds a project from the published `objectstack-platform` skill instead of `npm create objectstack`. The skill ships to customer projects inside `@objectstack/skills`.
- **Cost of not doing it:** the 〈Complete Working Example〉 `package.json` in `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` L147–L153 gives `^17.0.0` for all five `@objectstack/*` packages. That is a major behind the release line (18.1.0) and a caret range, which the v18 docs say not to use (`content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx` L206 「Pin exact versions instead of caret ranges」; `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` L64 「Pin the exact version in production」). A reader who copies it installs 17.x.

## Measured on `main`

- `packages/create-objectstack/src/pkg-utils.ts` `syncObjectStackDeps` writes `deps[dep] = version` for every `@objectstack/*` dep: the scaffolder's own version, exactly (PR #25539, merged 2026-10-23).
- PR #25665 (open, `Fixes #25510`) makes the committed template baseline match; it touches no `skills/**` file.
- `git grep '\^17' skills/` hits only these five lines for package versions; `engines: { protocol: '^17' }` in `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142 is the protocol handshake range, a different value, and is out of scope here.

## Wanted

The five `@objectstack/*` entries pin one exact version (the current release, `18.1.0`), and one prose line says the scaffolder writes its own version exactly and every `@objectstack/*` package stays on the same one. `typescript` keeps its range.

## Reader (who acts)

The `domain:skills` seat, in-seat. `skills/**` is Tier H: the PR lands by the maintainer's hand.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n '"\^1[0-9]\.' skills/` finds no `@objectstack/*` caret range.
- `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility` green.
- Writes: PR only through the relay's `pr_create`; ⛔ GitHub MCP writes.

## Dedupe

Governed half of #25510 (same split as #24974 for #24926). Searched open issues for "bootstrap.md ^17 pin exact skills": no other carrier. **New.**
